title: Reading ar and or with bossy r

figure.name: x-word
figure.note: a and r make one sound.

explain.say: Meet bossy r! When r comes after a vowel, it bosses the vowel into a new sound. Look at the car on the board. The word car has three letters but just two sounds.

draw.text: Reading ar and or with bossy r

draw.name: x-word
draw.note: a and r make one sound.

explain.say: The first part glows: c, the first sound in kite. Tap it on your arm. Ready for the bossy part?

draw.name: x-word
draw.note: a and r make one sound.

explain.say: Now a and r together make the sound you hear in car and star. Open wide, like at the doctor. Car! Two taps, two sounds. Can you say car, star and park?

draw.name: x-word
draw.note: a and r make one sound.

explain.say: Now o and r. Together they make the sound you hear in fork and corn. Look at fork on the board: three sounds. Tap and blend. Can you hear it?
Look at the board: ar words and or words, each in their own family. Super reading! Challenge: which animal on a farm has or in its name?

faq.a: Bossy r is an r after a vowel that changes its sound. a and r make the sound in car. o and r make the sound in fork.
ar makes the sound you hear in car, star and park. Open your mouth wide, like at the doctor.
or makes the sound you hear in fork, corn and horse.

faq.q: Does everyone say ar the same way?
faq.a: Not quite. In some places people say the r strongly, and in others it is very soft. Both are right. Say it the way people around you do.
asks: Why does my friend say car differently?

faq.q: How do I spot ar and or when I read?
faq.a: Look for a vowel with an r right after it. Draw a little loop round the two letters, then say them as one sound.
asks: How do I find bossy r?

facts: The word car has three letters but only two sounds.
When r comes after a vowel, as in car and fork, it changes the sound of the vowel.

quiz.say: How many sounds are in car?
quiz.why: c makes one sound, and a with r makes one sound: two sounds.

wrong.0: There is the c sound and then the ar sound.
wrong.2: Car has three letters, but a and r make one sound.

quiz.say: Which word has the or sound?
quiz.why: Horse has o and r together, like in fork.

wrong.1: Hat has a short a and no r.
wrong.2: Jar has the ar sound, like car.
